notes.problem: Grey extruded bars on a graph-paper lattice, no pool, no tissue-world material.
notes.fix: Remove the lattice and build the one and four unit lengths as glass slides laid end to end on the bench, with a raking pool on the fourth slide's cut end.

notes.problem: A bar chart in clay, frosted and steel bars one flat mid grey on a plate ruled like graph paper, nothing near white.
notes.fix: Delete the grid ruling, model the unit bar as pale frosted glass and the four-unit bar as polished steel with one hard specular line, and lengthen the cut end's cast.

notes.problem: Mid grey bars on a graph-paper grid read as a spreadsheet chart. The 4-unit bar is unlabelled, and the stub running off the right edge is unexplained at feed size.
notes.fix: Delete the graph grid under the bars, name the long bar SPACER in DOM, and let the key catch only the 4-unit bar's top bevel so it is the one bright edge on a near-black plate.

notes.problem: The same grey chart smaller, a flat mid grey strip across a ruled grid.
notes.fix: Make the 21 a row of the same glass slides and light only the 21st slide's end.

notes.problem: The same grey chart at a farther scale, three bars one material, no bright edge.
notes.fix: Plain black anodised plate, a pale frosted unit bar, polished steel 4 and 21 bars each with one raking specular and a long cast, one engraved scale under the 21 bar.

notes.problem: The same grey chart at a farther scale, no SPACER label, in the cold grey that breaks the warm tissue palette.
notes.fix: Remove the grid texture and label the 21 bar SPACER. Give the SPACER bars the mucin glaze with a crest highlight and keep the 1-unit bar in cold steel.

notes.problem: Same as 2, the count's end reads as more dark.
notes.fix: A lit pool where the 37th slide ends.

notes.problem: Same material fault as 2, no light where the count stops.
notes.fix: Same label and bevel change, a lit pool after the 37th slide and one ember accent on that last section.

notes.problem: Near-duplicate of frame 2, the sections barely separate from the black glass at 432 px, and the empty bench reads as nothing.
notes.fix: Rim-light each section with the darkfield edge used on frame 9 so every slide reads as a separate lit object.

notes.problem: Slides sink into the bench, grey label ends the brightest mass.
notes.fix: Drop the label ends two stops and raise the key's graze on the bevels so each slide gets one bright edge.

notes.problem: Charcoal matte tiles, label ends about L* 30, no lit bevel, sections flat speckle.
notes.fix: Raise each label end to a pale frosted value, run a lit rim along every slide's upper-left bevel, rim light each section.

notes.problem: The kerb sits at the nest's own value and disappears at 432 px, T cells spread evenly.
notes.fix: Raise the kerb into a lit ring with a crisp cast, thin the far right T cells and concentrate them at the ringed group.

notes.problem: The ringed group of neighboring cells is invisible at feed size and the label leader ends in clutter.
notes.fix: Raise the kerb around the one group into a lit ridge with a dark moat outside it, and clear the T cells from everywhere except that group and the nest margin.

notes.problem: The coat is a matte slate band, a different surface from frame 7's globule wall.
notes.fix: Re-surface the coat with 4 to 10 px glossy globules, keeping its profile and crop.

notes.problem: The funders as engraved lines can't be decoded, and the stage hardware occupies most of the art band with the section small in the centre.
notes.fix: Crop in on the section over the lit aperture until it fills a third to half of the frame.
